text:
maria: heads up — large spike of 5xx from forwarder-01 in prod over the last ~45m, alert firing a lot. proposing a 2h mute window while we investigate, or alternatively raising the error-rate threshold from 0.5% -> 1.5% for the cluster. thoughts? :eyes:

tom: can you post the dashboard + a trace link? want to confirm if it's traffic spike vs backend flakiness

maria: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/forwarder-prod-errors (top panel = 5xx by host). traces: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=forwarder-01&since=1h

alex: if it's scoped to forwarder-01 we should avoid a global threshold bump. can we change alert to group_by cluster and mute only for forwarder-01? also can we add a short cooldown (15m) after a mute so it doesn't re-fire?

rachel: any recent deploys to forwarder-01? I think there was a config roll last night but CI said green.

deploy-bot: deploy forwarder/2026.03.16-12:02 by @ci-bot succeeded to prod-forwarder-01 :rocket:

maria: yeah deploy at ~12:02 UTC. errors start ~12:20 and spike intermittently. looks correlated but not 1:1. logs show a mix of 502s and occasional auth token errors.

tom: how noisy is the alert? is it paging or just slack? if paging we should mute ASAP and open a follow-up ticket.

maria: it's PagerDuty (P1 currently). paging is noisy, multiple oncall fyi.

alex: suggested action: 1) apply a 2h mute for forwarder-01 via alertmanager (mute by label: instance=prod-forwarder-01). 2) change alert rule to group_by=[cluster,alertname] and set for 10m evaluation before page. 3) create a follow-up runbook task to root cause auth token refresh. snippet to mute:```# curl to alertmanager API to silence
POST /api/v1/silences
{
  "matchers": [{"name": "instance", "value": "prod-forwarder-01", "isRegex": false}],
  "startsAt": "2026-03-16T12:50:00Z",
  "endsAt": "2026-03-16T14:50:00Z",
  "createdBy": "maria",
  "comment": "temporary mute for noisy 5xx while we investigate"
}
```

rachel: sounds good. If we mute, please also add a Grafana panel link + a P0->P2 downgrade note in the PD incident so rotations know.

maria: will do. creating PD note now and kicking off token-refresh check. I'll apply the silence in alertmanager after 2 approvals.

tom: +1 from me.

alex: +1. after mute, let's also add a short-term alert variant that fires to slack (non-paging) for the cluster so we still see trend.

maria: mute applied at 1769460000 (alertmanager). created ticket INF-4823 for token refresh analysis and linked dashboards. leaving non-paging slack alert as alex suggested. thanks all :thumbsup:
